title: What's New — Auto Research
summary: PulseGuard now researches unresolved items before deciding what to keep or safely fix, and System & Performance warnings now show the exact details.

items.heading: Auto Research Engine
items.detail: UNKNOWN and REVIEW startup/service items are checked against local executable path, signature, publisher, installed-app ownership and hardware/feature evidence. Confirmed decisions are learned in a per-PC research cache.

items.heading: Safe decisions only
items.detail: Weak evidence never causes deletion. SAFE-DISABLE requires a proven dead startup target plus the existing rollback path; otherwise PulseGuard chooses KEEP or REVIEW.

items.heading: Smarter registry research
items.detail: A missing compatibility setting can become SAFE-FIX only when the target is gone, its drive is online and no installed application still owns it. Rollback data is saved before removal.

items.heading: Clickable repair details
items.detail: System & Performance Scan rows can now be clicked to show the underlying Deep Clean, registry and verification results instead of a vague Warning label.

items.heading: Warnings reconciled
items.detail: Locked browser cache files are treated as safe skips, and registry warnings clear when the final rescan proves zero SAFE-FIX entries remain.
